title: prepare emits the herding-exec payload; the model guard denies the Agent path
action: Per D4/D5/D6: (a) prepare_dispatch gains a Resolved::Herding arm beside the cli arm (prepare.rs:739-747 shape): tool "Bash", command exactly `.bee/bin/bee herding run --task-file - --json` plus `--cwd <worktree_path>` when the feature has a granted worktree (read the same grant source other prepare arms use if one exists; otherwise omit --cwd), payload.stdin = the same prompt body the cli arm pipes, channel "herding-exec". kind!=cell (gather/reviewer/advisor) never reaches this arm — ht-1 already resolves those to a model. The payload carries the brief only, no bee verbs for the worker (D6). (b) model_guard: a herding-resolved tier on an Agent/Task dispatch denies with transport "herding-tier-denied" and a FIX naming the Bash herding-exec path — mirror the cli-tier-denied wording at model_guard.rs:651-665; add the Slot/Resolved variants its local resolver needs. Tests: prepare cell-kind herding slot -> exact command string + stdin present + channel; guard denies with the new transport token; cli paths untouched.
verify: PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml drivers && PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml model_guard
